Run an exit node

## Usage

```console
coder exit-node server [flags]
```

## Description

```console
Run an exit node replica. The replica registers with coderd using its token, joins the tailnet at a deterministic address derived from its exit node and replica IDs, and accepts HTTP CONNECT requests from workspace agents on the listen port. Agents older than API 2.14 cannot consume replica-aware configurations. Restart workspaces on the new agent before binding exit nodes. Send SIGHUP to reload the policy file.
```
